snippet.title: Danganronpa: Survivor's Guilt - trailer 2
snippet.description:
Danganronpa: Survivor's Guilt is an upcoming Fangan (Danganronpa fan game) created by Aru & Raven. It's a sequel to DR: LIVe or Die, but it can be fully enjoyed even without the knowledge of the first game. The Prologue and Chapter 1 are scheduled to release this autumn.

This is the second trailer for the game, and first full-size gameplay trailer. The footage comes from an in-progress version of the game that is subject to change.

Twitter: https://twitter.com/DR_LIVeordie
Discord: https://discord.gg/Y4TuKmqst6
Carrd: https://drliveordietrilogy.carrd.co/
